#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>
#include <utility>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

long long compute_gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    if (b == 0) return a;
    return compute_gcd(b, a % b);
}

long long compute_lcm(long long a, long long b) {
    return a * (b / compute_gcd(a, b));
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    long long x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    
    if (y <= n) {
        long long g = compute_gcd(x, y);
        while (g != 1) {
            x /= g;
            y /= g;
            g = compute_gcd(x, y);
        }
        cout << x << "/" << y;
        return 0;
    }
    
    pair<long long, long long> best = {1, 1};
    double smallest_error = 1e18;
    
    for (long long i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        long long L = compute_lcm(i, y);
        long long target = x * (L / y);
        long long unit = L / i;
        
        // try floor
        long long q_floor = target / unit;
        long long approx_floor = q_floor * unit;
        double error_floor = abs(target - approx_floor) / static_cast<double>(L);
        
        if (error_floor < smallest_error) {
            smallest_error = error_floor;
            best = {q_floor, i};
        }
        
        // try ceil
        long long q_ceil = (target + unit - 1) / unit;
        long long approx_ceil = q_ceil * unit;
        double error_ceil = abs(target - approx_ceil) / static_cast<double>(L);
        
        if (error_ceil < smallest_error) {
            smallest_error = error_ceil;
            best = {q_ceil, i};
        }
    }
    
    long long g = compute_gcd(best.first, best.second);
    best.first /= g;
    best.second /= g;
    
    cout << best.first << "/" << best.second;
    return 0;
}
